<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>ECI extends voter revision:</strong> The Election Commission has extended the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) timelines for Delhi, Maharashtra, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Haryana, and Nagaland.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxOMDM0T3doYjd0bDFtSzFzOWtwRmoxNjdjSHpyVXRyWnNuUnV6R1dKVXd5bndHNHR0U1NNUmNIemEtbjhfX3psQ3FaTHlmMkdpYWxOY0tkdURZMmNPTGxTSWlFQVc1dmdxR1RocVBYaFR5MGp4cDNsVFRZVXRBYklRTEFSN082V2N0eUp5cWJ4ckw3TDJjTEE0b09EMU9SeGFqRkNnX0RCSXN0Y1p6Q3RzQjBsaw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a></span></li>
